name: Lisa Reynolds

bio.statement: Her official legislative page describes Reynolds as a pediatrician with two decades of experience serving patients.
bio.excerpt: As a pediatrician with two decades of experience serving patients on the frontline

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: Her official page says she chairs the Senate Committee on Early Childhood and Behavioral Health.
bio.excerpt: I am proud to serve as the Chair of the Senate Committee on Early Childhood and Behavioral Health

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Reynolds lists her occupation as pediatrician and state senator, with The Children's Clinic since 1995, state representative 2021-2024 and state senator since 2024.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Pediatrician, State Senator Occupational Background: The Children’s Clinic, 1995-present; Oregon State Representative, 2021-2024; Oregon State Senator, 2024-present.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

bio.statement: Reynolds lists a BA from the University of Chicago and an MD from the UCLA School of Medicine.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: University of Chicago, BA; UCLA School of Medicine, MD

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

bio.statement: Reynolds lists legislator and Multnomah County Citizen Budget Advisory Committee as her prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Legislator; Citizen Budget Advisory Committee, Multnomah County

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: In the Oregon Capital Chronicle 2026 voter guide, Reynolds says housing should be made more affordable with less red tape and fewer restrictions.
positions.excerpt: We must make housing more affordable with less red tape, fewer restrictions

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: In the same voter guide, Reynolds says the state tax structure is regressive and should change.
positions.excerpt: We must change our tax structure, which continues to be regressive, harming lower-income people more.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: In the voter guide, Reynolds cites improving access to health care, including behavioral health services, as a motivation.
positions.excerpt: improving access to health care, including behavioral health services

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

positions.statement: In an August 2026 Oregon Capital Chronicle story, Reynolds describes cannabis-related psychosis risk as a long-term disability and plans 2027 regulation proposals.

source.publisher: Portland Tribune (Oregon Capital Chronicle)

positions.statement: Reynolds cites legislation protecting patients, children in schools and people in their homes in response to the Trump administration.
positions.excerpt: Responded to the Trump administration with policies that protect patients in hospitals, children in schools, and people in their homes.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Reynolds cites supporting the highest K-12 budget in Oregon history, including early literacy funding.
positions.excerpt: Supported the highest K-12 budget expenditure in Oregon history, including funding for early literacy programs.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Reynolds cites establishing the Oregon Child Tax Credit and fighting for affordable childcare.
positions.excerpt: Established the Oregon Child Tax Credit and fought for affordable childcare.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Reynolds cites championing access to abortion services and protections and funding for providers.
positions.excerpt: Championed access to abortion services and bolstered protections and funding for providers.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Reynolds cites passing gun safety legislation that outlawed bump stocks.
positions.excerpt: Passed gun safety legislation, protecting children from gun violence and outlawing bump stocks.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Reynolds cites keeping vaccines widely available in Oregon.
positions.excerpt: Kept vaccines widely available in our state in the face of federal threats.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 42
